verdicts.reason: A scrambles the reading order: the 'Reserve a Case' CTA sits above the headline, the 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy, and the orange divider strikes through 'Ships late June'. The text is jammed into a cramped mid band, with large dead navy areas above and below it. B is worse: the CTA pill is crammed into the top-left corner, straddling the white header band next to the logo, and the divider line cuts through the body copy ('gone until'). It also has the same out-of-order eyebrow, cramped text with no space between blocks, and a huge empty void above the headline.
